task: Original stability rationale for Djules V443; static archive audit only
archive_policy: Primary D: SSD. H: safety copy must not be used for routine work or automatic fallback.

historical_findings.fact: Structural reconfiguration was treated as a transaction: drain resource ownership, clear stale continuity, bypass generation for one wall-clock second, then re-prime.
historical_findings.scope: Color swapchain creation/destruction, enumerated image replacement, projection resource/subrect changes and hard generation/submission failures.
historical_findings.validation_record: V23058 reports 39/39 combined tests; headset validation explicitly pending.
historical_findings.limit: These documents do not establish that the creation timer alone fixed a specific observed crash. They describe a combined stability measure.

historical_findings.fact: Retained live game motion-vector resources could be overwritten/reused before synthesis. Private per-stream snapshots addressed wrong images and late GPU stall/crash.
V23051 headset run ended with DXGI_ERROR_DEVICE_HUNG shortly after live vector-source switching. Disabling tracking freed snapshots before outstanding GPU work had been retired.
historical_findings.fix: Stop publication immediately, retain snapshots, retire only after OFXR GPU work is idle; restart logical epochs safely.
historical_findings.limit: This is a distinct lifetime issue, not evidence that a one-second swapchain creation timer was required.

historical_findings.fact: D11 and D12 generation resources were created during swapchain image enumeration. The current projection-first lazy arming did not exist there.

current_protections.detail: Creation remains serialized by frame_call_mutex; active presenter is drained before taking its content lock and dropping the retained repeat. Constructor at line8968.
Enumeration marks eligibility pending. Actual projected first use passes through and clears continuity before generation resources are armed after downstream submission.
Lifetime guard, continuity/repeat reset and synchronous GPU drain remain. The old destroy-only timer is already absent.
Image replacement, mapping/layout changes and hard failures retain their existing quarantine policies. V443 must not remove them.

conclusion.disposition: Recommend V443 in shared lifecycle code, removing only swapchain_created quarantine scheduling.
conclusion.reason: The fixed delay compensated for early arming during structural reconfiguration. Current lazy arming plus preserved lifetime guards address that mechanism explicitly. Creation of an unused overlay does not justify a generation outage.
must_preserve: Vector snapshot ownership and safe switching
conclusion.benefit: Avoid repeated one-second generation outages when an application creates color overlay swapchains or creates a new projection before destroying the old one.
conclusion.risk: Lifecycle regression if an Autonomous-specific queued/director/AFW path is assumed equivalent without coverage. Existing guard/reset costs can remain; no zero-hitch or measured latency claim.
conclusion.runtime_gate: Before sealing an implementation: cover overlay create/destroy during generation, both projection replacement orders, D11/D12 image re-enumeration, presenter repeats, queued/director and FSR/AFW consumers, pending/failing GPU work and surviving hard-failure quarantines.
conclusion.not_proven: This static review is not a new headset stability test. Historical 39/39 and upstream V443 tests are records, not local reruns.

owner_scopes.V443: Shared creation-only timer removal; preserve all actual safety mechanisms
